A cryptographically secure, on-chain list of {{< var treaty_campaign_voting_bloc_target_nounit >}} verified supporters is not an "analogy" or a "metaphor" or a "nice idea."

It is the largest political mandate in human history. Nothing else comes close.

Politicians can ignore protests. They can ignore polls. They can ignore reality for surprisingly long periods (see: climate change, 1970-present).

## What You're Actually Building

### The Goal

Build a privacy-preserving, globally verifiable referendum. It shows public support for a [1% treaty](../solution/1-percent-treaty.qmd) and your [decentralized institutes of health](../solution/dih.qmd). Essentially, a website where people say "please stop letting me die of stupid things" in a way that lawyers find convincing.

![The five things you need for a global referendum that politicians can't ignore: real votes, secret votes, fair votes, visible votes, and viral growth.](/assets/images/global-referendum/global-referendum-section-the-goal-bw-academic.jpg)

Requirements:

- Must be auditable (so politicians can't claim it's fake, though they will absolutely try)
- Must be persuasive (so policymakers actually do their jobs for once)
- Must hit **{{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct >}} global participation** ({{< var treaty_campaign_voting_bloc_target_nounit >}}+ verified votes)

That last number isn't arbitrary. Once {{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct >}} of a population actively supports something, it becomes unstoppable. Every time. Across all cultures. For centuries. More on that later.

**The Principles (Or: How Not to Build a Fraudulent Voting System):**

- **Verifiability**: Cryptographic proofs that votes are real (can't fake the math, though politicians will try)
- **Privacy**: Nobody knows who you voted for (including us)
- **Equity**: Works for everyone, including people without bank accounts or government IDs (which is most of Earth, by the way)
- **Transparency**: Open-source code so anyone can audit it
- **Viral Growth**: Needs to spread organically. Target: <$1.00 per verified participant (includes referral payment + biometric verification + platform overhead)

The trick is doing all of these simultaneously. It's like juggling while riding a bicycle while the bicycle is on fire. But the alternative is everyone dies of preventable diseases, so the bicycle stays on fire.

## System Architecture (Or: Math That Politicians Can't Argue With)

The voting system uses **end-to-end verifiable cryptography**: receipts that prove you voted, without proving *how* you voted.
Politicians can claim polls are fake.
They cannot claim math is fake. (Several have tried. The math won every time.)

![Your vote gets encrypted, mixed with everyone else's votes like a cryptographic smoothie, then posted publicly. You can verify yours; nobody knows it's yours.](/assets/images/global-referendum/global-referendum-section-end-to-end-verifiable-system-bw-academic.jpg)

Each voter gets a cryptographic receipt. All ballots are published anonymized. Zero-knowledge proofs guarantee the count is legitimate. Your biometric data never leaves your device. All code is open-source. It's the most transparent election in history, which is an embarrassingly low bar.

## On Stopping People from Cheating (The Hard Part)

Your species has a gift for ruining voting systems. You've been cheating at democracy since you invented it. Three escalating verification layers:

1. **Basic checks** (stops ~90% of fraud): email/phone OTP, device fingerprinting, IP geolocation
2. **Enhanced verification** (higher trust, higher rewards): government e-ID integration (Estonia [@estonia-eresidency-stats], India Aadhaar [@indian-aadhaar-system], EU eIDAS [@eu-eidas-network], US via ID.me [@id-me-verification]), biometric liveness detection, proof-of-uniqueness partners (Worldcoin [@worldcoin-scale], BrightID [@brightid-social-verification-network], Gitcoin Passport [@gitcoin-passport])
3. **Social verification**: community attestation for people without digital IDs

![Layer 1: Are you human? Layer 2: Are you a real human? Layer 3: Are you a real human who hasn't voted already?](/assets/images/global-referendum/global-referendum-section-verification-layers-bw-academic.jpg)

Even Layer 1 gets you counted. You don't need a passport to say "I would prefer not to die."
AI fraud detection catches edge cases: >99% detection, <1% false positives.
Biometric data stays on your device, encrypted with keys you control. (Yes, better privacy than your actual government gives you. The bar was underground.)
Compliant with GDPR [@gdpr-biometric-data], CCPA/CPRA [@ccpa-cpra-compliance], BIPA [@illinois-bipa], and COPPA [@coppa-compliance].

Surprisingly easy, if you pay them. Your species downloaded TikTok over 4 billion times to watch strangers dance. You can get {{< var treaty_campaign_voting_bloc_target_nounit >}} to click "yes" on not dying.

The growth engine is a viral referral system funded by [Incentive Alignment Bonds](../solution/incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd). Target: <$1.00 per verified participant. For comparison, acquiring a coffee customer costs $5-15. Nike pays $40 to get one person to buy shoes online. We're asking for under a dollar to save lives. The economics of your civilization are genuinely upsetting.

## Integrity (Proving You Didn't Cheat)

People will claim you cheated. This is inevitable. Your species accuses people of cheating at everything, including children's football, baking competitions, and board games at Thanksgiving.

The defense: make cheating mathematically impossible, then publish the math. NGO and academic observers get read-only dashboards with real-time fraud detection. You're inviting the entire planet to watch you not cheat, which is more transparency than any election in your history has offered.

You can't just pay people to click buttons. Well, you can, but then you get garbage data and angry economists. So: participants complete structured learning paths before voting. Higher reward tiers unlock as you learn more.
Result: informed participants, not confused button-clickers. (Though honestly, confused button-clickers who want to not die are also welcome.)

**Legal positioning**: Non-binding global consultation. Country-specific bridges to official mechanisms where feasible. Constitutional law scholars review for legitimacy. (Lawyers love reviewing things. It's basically all they do.)

## Success Metrics

**How you know it's working:**

- **{{< var treaty_campaign_voting_bloc_target_nounit >}}+ verified participants** (the magic {{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct >}} threshold)
- **<$1.00 per verified participant** (cheaper than a latte, and the product is "not dying")

Secondary metrics track geographic distribution, brand awareness, and whether politicians have started sweating yet. (The sweat metric is informal but surprisingly reliable. They always sweat before they act.)

### On Why {{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct >}} Is The Magic Number

The {{< var treaty_campaign_voting_bloc_target_nounit >}} target isn't pulled from thin air. It's based on the "{{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct >}} Rule," a historical pattern that has held across cultures, centuries, and continents with the reliability of a physical law:

**When {{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct >}} of a population actively participates in sustained, nonviolent action, the movement wins. Every time.**

The evidence:

- **Civil Rights (US):** Crossed the {{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct >}} threshold. Ended segregation.
- **Indian Independence:** Crossed the {{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct >}} threshold. Kicked out the British Empire.
- **Women's Suffrage:** Crossed the {{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct >}} threshold. Won the vote.

Once you hit {{< var global_population_activism_threshold_pct >}}, three things happen simultaneously: it's clearly not a fringe movement, the support is geographically distributed, and opposition becomes career suicide.

Previous movements required marching in the rain, getting tear-gassed, or going to prison. This one requires clicking a button from the toilet. The barrier to entry is lower. The incentive (healthcare you actually want) is higher. It's the easiest revolution in human history, which is fitting, because the problem (letting people die of curable diseases) is the stupidest crisis in human history.

![3.5% of people actively pushing for change is enough to topple governments. It's a historical pattern, like gravity but for revolutions.](/assets/images/global-referendum/global-referendum-section-on-why-3-5-is-the-magic-number-bw-academic.jpg)

People show up for the healthcare. Politicians see {{< var treaty_campaign_voting_bloc_target_nounit >}} verified supporters. The treaty becomes inevitable.

It's not manipulation. It's just understanding what motivates humans (not dying) and what motivates politicians (not losing elections). These two facts have been true for your entire history. Nobody thought to combine them until now.
